evidence.whyNotSweepMeasurement: /compliance/obligations/[id] is sweepEligible:false in apps/web/lib/ux-budget/route-shells.generated.json with reason dynamic-fixture-required — the sweep fixture mints no obligation, so it publishes no concrete path for this dynamic route and the served DOM cannot be measured. A sweep-measurement manifest for this route would therefore have to carry numbers no run produced. Making the route measurable means adding its honest fixture context, which is its own change; it is filed rather than folded in here.
